recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot studio portrait of a woman in an oversized mustard-yellow suit, set against a cool-toned, desaturated blue-grey background. The composition is balanced by a large, stylized typographic lockup in the upper right quadrant featuring overlapping script and serif elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm mustard yellow of the suit vs. cool desaturated blue background
Sharp, oversized tailoring of the garment vs. soft, voluminous curls of the hair
Interlocking script and rigid serif typography in the upper right
Vertical secondary text balancing the horizontal weight of the subject
coreInvariants: Oversized shoulder pads in the blazer
High-contrast lighting on the face with soft shadows
Mint green and black color palette for the primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright mustard yellow blazer acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down the line of the blazer, then jump to the large typographic logo on the right, following the vertical text downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the right side to accommodate complex typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the subject's clothing contrasted against a low-saturation, high-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary name uses a ultra-condensed, high-contrast serif with elongated ascenders.
Secondary name is rendered in a fluid, calligraphic script that overlaps the serif text.
Script features long, sweeping swashes that encircle parts of the serif letters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' and 'y' in the serif font are extremely elongated.
The script 'W' is stylized with sharp, zig-zagging strokes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast juxtaposition of expressive, overlapping display type with rigid, vertically-oriented metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, condensed serif structure of the primary name.
Captures the fluid, energetic movement of the overlapping script.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with voluminous dark curls wearing an oversized mustard yellow blazer and matching trousers over a black crop top. The background should be a clean, slightly vignetted desaturated blue-grey. Position the subject on the left side of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large typographic lockup in the upper right. Use a condensed black serif font for the top word and a mint green script font for the bottom word, ensuring they overlap. Add a vertical line of lowercase, widely-spaced serif text along the right edge.

verificationChecks: Is the blazer a distinct mustard yellow?
Does the script text overlap the serif text?
Is the subtitle text oriented vertically?
Is the background a cool, desaturated tone?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and title text
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for proper shoulder pad volume in the blazer
Verify the mint green color matches the 80s palette
Ensure vertical text is legible and properly spaced
Confirm the subject is offset to the left
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Oversized Mustard Suit + [Cool Background Color] + [Overlapping Serif/Script Typography] + Vertical Metadata
